heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP - HYDROPONIC GREENHOUSE - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. GENERATION SHIP - HYDROPONIC GREENHOUSE - NIGHT CYCLE
Rows of silver-leafed plants glow beneath violet lamps.
Condensation drips from the ceiling ribs.
A warning light pulses amber over the far hatch.
CAPTAIN HELEN ADEBAYO-STONE (50s, grey braid, quartermaster's coat) strides between the rows with a handheld scanner.
DR. MIKLOS VARGA (60s, bowtie, stooped) trails her carrying a sample tray.
ENSIGN PIA LINDGREN (20s, new uniform, calm eyes) walks backward ahead of them, watching the hatch.
Report, Ensign.
units.name: HELEN

units.text: Nothing on the other side, Captain. Not heat, not sound.
units.name: PIA

units.text: That's precisely what worries me.
units.name: VARGA

units.text: Doctor, you're worried by cloud cover.
units.name: HELEN

units.text: Captain, the plants have stopped turning toward the lamps.
units.name: VARGA

units.text: Helen halts.
She sweeps the scanner across the nearest row.
Every leaf, in the violet light, is bent the same way.
Toward the hatch.
Captain?
units.name: PIA

units.text: Back away, slowly.
units.name: HELEN

units.text: The amber light goes red.
The hatch hisses.
A thin line of white mist spills across the floor and curls up the base of the trays.
Varga drops his sample tray; glass bursts.
Pia grabs Helen's arm and Helen grabs Varga's collar, and the three of them stumble backward together as the nearest plants lean, in unison, to follow them.
They're listening.
units.name: VARGA

units.text: Then stop talking.
units.name: HELEN

units.text: The three of them freeze.
The leaves freeze too.
For a long moment the only sound is the dripping.
Then Pia reaches to her belt and, with infinite care, switches off her comm badge.
The mist halts.
The hatch seals itself shut with a soft click.
The plants slowly straighten toward the lamps.
Captain, I think it wanted the badge.
units.name: PIA

units.text: I think it wanted us.
units.name: HELEN

units.text: She lowers the scanner.
